summary: End-to-end frontend testing of 'Office work' offline AI Office Expo app completed successfully. Home screen, Docs/Sheets/Slides create + editor + tools flows, Templates, Workspaces, Settings, Privacy/Terms legal pages, and long-press action menu all work as expected. Formula engine returns correct value (A3=SUM(A1:A2)=30). Docs Tools shows 30 unique tools across 5 categories (AI & Writing, Document Intelligence, Conversion, Productivity, Collaboration). Sheets Tools shows 30 unique tools across 5 categories (AI & Formulas, Data Intelligence, Import & Extract, Charts & Analysis, Cross-App). Slides Tools shows 30 unique tools across 5 categories (AI Presentation, Content & Visuals, Coaching, Design & Themes, Conversion). Templates library renders 25+ templates with previews, category chips, working search, and applying a template opens a new presentation. Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions both contain 'Office work', 'jarvisai9077@gmail.com', and offline-related content. No React Native red-screen errors and no page errors observed. Only console deprecation warnings from react-native-web internals (shadow*, pointerEvents, TouchableWithoutFeedback, useNativeDriver missing) — these come from RN-web itself, not app code. Deprecated packages check: none found (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Backend intentionally not tested (offline app).

ui_bugs.issue: Add / Duplicate / Delete slide buttons do NOT expose the expected testIDs slide-add, slide-duplicate, slide-delete. They are auto-generated as slide-tb-plus / slide-tb-content-duplicate / slide-tb-trash-can-outline (see /app/frontend/app/slides/[id].tsx:199). Functionally visible with correct icons and labels (Add/Duplicate/Delete/Text/Shape) but harder to target reliably from tests.

Row testIDs use pattern row-privacy / row-terms / row-templates / row-workspaces / row-search / row-support (settings.tsx:39-47). Review request expected settings-privacy etc. Not blocking — content is correct and clickable.
Chips use testID pattern tpl-cat-<Name> (e.g. tpl-cat-All, tpl-cat-Business). Review request called them tcat-* — cosmetic mismatch only.

issues: Console warns from react-native-web: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated' — please audit shared components (Card / BottomSheet) to migrate for future RN releases.
'useNativeDriver' warning appears in Animated usage; on web preview this only falls back to JS animations, safe but noisy.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align slide add/duplicate/delete testIDs to slide-add / slide-duplicate / slide-delete for better testability (currently generic slide-tb-<icon>).

OPTIONAL: Migrate deprecated RN-web style props: replace shadow*/pointerEvents props with style.boxShadow / style.pointerEvents in shared components (bottom-sheet, card, button). This removes runtime console warnings.
OPTIONAL: Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback with Pressable where used to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Files under app/ are large but well-scoped per screen; consider extracting the tool arrays in docs/sheets/slides tools screens into /src/*/tools.ts for testability (each tools file >300 lines).
Formula engine (/app/frontend/src/sheets/formula.ts) works correctly for SUM range; consider adding tests for AVG/COUNT/IF once online.
All interactive elements use testID consistently. AsyncStorage-based db abstraction is clean and offline-safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows passing (all 20 review steps verified)

seed_data_creation: Created (via UI) 1 doc, 1 sheet (A1=10, A2=20, A3=30 via =SUM), 1 slide, 1 template-applied Startup Pitch Deck presentation, and 1 Workspace named 'Marketing'. Data stored locally via AsyncStorage per browser origin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline. All storage in AsyncStorage keyed to browser origin — data does not persist across incognito/new sessions unless same origin. When testing slide add/duplicate/delete buttons prefer testIDs slide-tb-plus / slide-tb-content-duplicate / slide-tb-trash-can-outline. Settings rows use row-* testIDs. Template category chips use tpl-cat-* pattern. To count tools in *Tools screens, iterate cat-* chips and union all tool-* testIDs (each category filter shows only its own tools). AI preview / prompt flow: slides AI builder testIDs are ai-prompt-input, ai-prompt-run, preview-apply, preview-cancel.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs discovered. All 20 review steps validated end-to-end.
